rule: Claude Pro/Max is a default subscription route, separate from Anthropic API billing. Hermes manual PKCE uses S256, 32 random bytes and an independent state; pasted code#state must match. JSON exchange and refresh use the same platform.claude.com endpoint and public client. Persist a before-send attempt and committed replacement under the transactional CredentialStore lock before returning access; an omitted replacement requires sign-in again; never replay a refused or uncertain refresh. A refresh with no answer, a server error, a refusal that does not prove the grant revoked or a storage failure before sending keeps the sign-in and tries the same grant next time; only invalid_grant removes it. No installed credentials or CLIs are read. Tokens stay on the person's device and are never logged.
